about_the_game:
Not A.C.A.B. puts you in the role of a dedicated police officer tasked with maintaining order in a living city. Your duty is to set up roadside checkpoints, inspect passing vehicles, and decide who goes free and who ends up behind bars. Every interaction matters, and every choice shapes your reputation as an officer of the law.

🚔 Dynamic Checkpoints

Deploy checkpoints across different areas of the city and stop vehicles at your discretion or respond to alerts about specific license plates reported as suspicious.

📱 Immersive Police Tablet

Access six detailed menus on your tablet:

  • Car: Review vehicle details.

  • Driver: Inspect licenses and check past violations.

  • Wanted List: Track down flagged vehicles.

  • Fines History: View all penalties you’ve issued so far.

  • Messages: Receive real-time updates from headquarters (e.g., escaped convicts, dangerous cargo).

  • Penalties: Issue tickets, impound vehicles, or escalate to arrest.

⚖️ Arrest or Release

With a single button press, decide the fate of the driver: let them go or put them in cuffs. But be careful push too hard and their Obstruction of Justice bar will rise, making them nervous, unpredictable, and more likely to bolt.

💬 Branching Dialogue System

Engage drivers with different tones friendly, neutral, tense, or sly and watch their responses shift based on your approach. Some may stay calm, others may panic… and some might even try to flee the scene.

🏁 High-Speed Pursuits

When suspects escape, jump into your patrol car and chase them down. Outdrive, outsmart, and apprehend them to earn extra rewards.

📊 Daily Routine & Progression

Your shift runs from 9:00 to 17:00. At the end of each day, review detailed statistics before heading into the next. Complete daily tasks to earn bonus cash and climb the ranks of law enforcement.

Not A.C.A.B. is more than a simulation it’s a test of judgment, intuition, and the thin line between control and chaos. Will you be a fair protector of the city, or a relentless enforcer of the law? The choice is yours.
